name: GoGoBoard Firmware v3.2.5
body:
- **Fixed Logo programs losing their variables.** Any program that used `dobackground`, `subscribemessage`, or `when` silently erased the variables that had already been set, replacing their values with `0`. Programs then behaved as though the hardware were broken:
  - motors driven with a variable duration (`onfor move_wait`) did not turn
  - `repeat` with a variable count never ran its body
  - `wait` with a variable delay did not pause
  - text variables were stored as `0.00`, so recorded sequences played back as nothing

  Variables now keep their values for the whole program run.

  This affected every release from 3.1.0 through 3.2.4. Upgrading is strongly recommended for any project that uses background blocks or message subscriptions.

GoGo Board version 7 or above

- Auto update. When existing firmware is version 2.5.0 or above, update can take place within the [code.gogoboard.org](https://code.gogoboard.org) environment.
- Manual update. Visit [install-firmware.gogoboard.org](https://install-firmware.gogoboard.org/) and follow the instructions.
  > [Firmware update manual](https://github.com/arnans/gogodoc/blob/main/firmware-update/firmware-update-guide.md)

- IR transmitter not working. (in development)
